mapper.select: SELECT * FROM t_practice WHERE id=#{id} FOR UPDATE
SELECT * FROM t_practice WHERE owner_id=#{owner} AND id<#{before} ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT #{size}
mapper.update: UPDATE t_practice SET status=#{to},version=version+1,started_at=IF(#{to2}='DOING',UTC_TIMESTAMP(3),started_at),finished_at=IF(#{to3} IN ('DONE','ABANDONED'),UTC_TIMESTAMP(3),finished_at) WHERE id=#{id}
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM t_practice p JOIN t_note n ON n.id=p.note_id WHERE p.id=#{id} AND p.public_status='PUBLISHED' AND n.status='PUBLISHED' AND p.source_revision=n.revision

SELECT p.id,p.note_id,p.owner_id AS author_id,p.result_text,p.helpfulness FROM t_practice p JOIN t_note n ON n.id=p.note_id WHERE p.note_id=#{note} AND p.id<#{before} AND p.public_status='PUBLISHED' AND n.status='PUBLISHED' AND p.source_revision=n.revision ORDER BY p.id DESC LIMIT #{size}
